profile: Name: Omkar Yelsange. Positioning: Data Analyst | Data Engineer | Data & ML Enthusiast. Based in Pune / Lonavala, Maharashtra, India; open to relocation across India.

Education: B.E. Robotics & Automation Engineering, D Y Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi, Pune, 2022-2026, CGPA 8.90/10. HSC (12th): D P Mehta Jr College, Lonavala, 2021-2022, 64.33%. SSC (10th): Adv Bapusaheb Bhonde High School, Lonavala, 2019-2020, 80%.

Target roles: Data Analyst, Data Engineer / Junior Data Engineer, Data Scientist / Junior Data Scientist, Business Intelligence, Data / ML roles. Interests: Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI.

Journey: started in Robotics & Automation engineering, moved toward software development, then data analytics, data engineering and data + ML. He enjoys the layer between raw data and usable intelligence: pipelines, transformations and analytics-ready data.
This portfolio website is built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion and three.js, with an in-site terminal and this AI assistant (Gemini API behind a serverless function).

Contact: email omkaryelsange1010@gmail.com; GitHub https://github.com/OmkarYelsange; LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/omkar-yelsange; portfolio https://omkaryelsange.vercel.app. Phone, salary expectation, notice period and joining date are not published: ask Omkar by email.

Experience (only three roles): 1) Data Analyst at Autoline Industries Ltd, June 2026 to present (collected live sensor data from physical industrial grinding machines; received the offer after a GET interview in June 2025). 2) Project Management Internship at Lumax Cornaglia Auto Technologies Pvt Ltd, Jan 2026 to Feb 2026. 3) Full Stack Development Internship at Drushya Digital India Pvt Ltd, Sept 2025 to Nov 2025. Detailed responsibilities of the internships are not published.

Skills - Programming: Python, SQL, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS. Analytics: Power BI, Excel, DAX, Tableau (practice), EDA, data cleaning, visualization, KPI analysis. Data engineering: Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, AWS S3, Glue, DataBrew, Athena, QuickSight, ETL/ELT, Medallion architecture. Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cloud SQL, SQLite. Web: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Flask, Django, Firebase. AI/ML: machine learning, NLP, generative AI, Gemini API. Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman, Vercel, Netlify, Render.
Projects are grouped as Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Software / Web Development and Hardware (in that order of preference).

DATA ENGINEERING - GoodCabs Analytics Platform (repo Databricks-Projects): Databricks pipeline Raw -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold with PySpark and SQL on city and trip data from AWS S3. Databricks Lakehouse Projects (repo Databricks): hands-on projects with Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and the Medallion architecture.

DATA ANALYTICS - AWS Healthcare Data Pipeline (repo AWS-DA): patient CSVs -> S3 -> Glue DataBrew -> Glue Crawler/Catalog -> Glue ETL -> Athena -> QuickSight (10 steps, serverless). Machine Monitoring Analytics M2 & M35: SQL analysis and KPI dashboards in Power BI and Excel. Airbnb NYC EDA: 20,770 listings, 22 attributes, Python (Manhattan priciest; beds vs price about 0.42; reviews vs reviews per month about 0.63). OLA Ride Analytics: 100,000 bookings, SQL scripts, Power BI dashboard, report and presentation. Zepto Inventory Analysis: SQL + Power BI. Blinkit Grocery Analytics: SQL, Excel, Power BI KPIs (these five are in repo Data-Analytics-Projects). Data Analyst Practice Lab (repo Data-Analyst): Excel Bike Sales dashboard, MySQL, Power BI, Python, Tableau Airbnb dashboard.

SOFTWARE / WEB DEVELOPMENT - SAMS Dashboard (React + Vite, Node.js/Express, MongoDB; real-time monitoring of grinding-machine sensor data). AI ChatBot (React + Vite + Tailwind, Flask, Gemini Flash 2.0). DeepSeek Clone (Next.js, Clerk auth, MongoDB, Markdown rendering). YouTube Video & Audio Downloader (Flask, Flask-Login, SQLite, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, MP4 up to 720p and MP3 192 kbps). Real-Time Chat App (React, Firebase, Zustand). React E-Commerce Store (React, Vite, Redux Toolkit, Clerk). AirBnB Clone (Node.js, Express, EJS). Voting System (Django, SQLite). IoT Device Platform (React, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, Recharts). Tools & Jobs is a private repository (details not published).

HARDWARE - SAMS: Smart Abrasive Monitoring System, the final-year project: sensor-based monitoring of grinding wheel efficiency in surface grinding using live data from physical grinding machines; Omkar was team lead and member. IoT Smart Chair Kit: attachable kit tracking posture, sitting time and weight distribution with sensors on ESP32 + Arduino Uno and a Blynk dashboard; team of four, Omkar handled IoT integration and documentation. The SAMS dashboard (web) is counted as a software project.

Certifications (latest first): Deloitte Data Analytics Job Simulation (March 2026); Paper presentation certificate for 'Sensor-based Monitoring of Grinding Wheel Efficiency in Surface Grinding Operation' from D Y Patil College of Engineering (May 2025); DIPEX State Level Competition Finalist (April 2025); First Consolation Prize at Utkarsh 2K25 national project-level competition (March 2025); Python 101 for Data Science, IBM Cognitive Class (Jan 2025); Prompt Engineering for Everyone, IBM Cognitive Class (Nov 2024).

Co-curricular: active team member of the SARA club in college (2024-2025); active participant in Tech Fest; runner-up at Utkarsh 2K25 national project-level competition (March 2025); finalist at DIPEX state-level competition (April 2025); active team lead and member of the final-year project; research paper published.
